ResearchProjectDef.label: stasis fields
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a wearable stasis generator. Where a shield belt repels what crosses its boundary, a stasis field holds everything inside it still - including the wearer. Nothing within can act, and nothing within can be harmed.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cryogenic munitions
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build throwable cryogenic charges. The burst does almost no damage; what it does is stop everything standing in it, friend and enemy alike, for long enough to flank, reload or drag somebody out.

ResearchProjectDef.label: remote ordnance
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a drone control rig and the demolition drones it deploys. The drone delivers a charge somewhere a grenade cannot be thrown, at the cost of an operator who cannot move or act while driving it.

ResearchProjectDef.label: holographic projection
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build throwable mimic beacons. A beacon projects a copy of whoever threw it: it cannot fight, but most people shoot at it instead of at your colonists, which is twenty seconds to retreat, reload or drag somebody out.

ResearchProjectDef.label: explosive tags
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make tag scrolls and the explosive tags they hold: paper slips that stick where they are thrown or laid and go off on a fuse or a hand seal. The wielder can throw single tags, lay a line of them along a corridor, or cover one enemy in them.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ricochet rounds
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make the bank shot pistol, a heavy pistol whose bullets bounce off walls. Its charged shot bounces off up to 3 walls and can hit a pawn the shooter cannot see.
